Introduction

IMLAY, born Im Jae-bim, is a South Korean producer and DJ under SM Entertainment and ScreaM Records. He released his first solo single, "Gaze," on February 24, 2015. As a composer, he has contributed to projects by SHINee, Super Junior, LOONA, BoA, EXO, aespa, and many more.

Since 2025, he has been appointed as a professor at Seoul National University of Arts.
